text.tspan: Messages between Node and BLE Peripheral
are link-layer events, not driven by the App.
The App only observes them through
Negotiated when MITM protection is not required
or IoCapabilities do not support authentication.
LTK is derived from the ECDH shared secret, not distributed.
For Passkey Entry the callback carries
isNumericComparison=false and the App responds via
Confirm / Random rounds (one per passkey bit).
See "Passkey Authentication" for the full flow.

NumberOfBondsChanged fires as a bond-aging (LRU) signal.
The reported N equals the current bond count and is unchanged.
per the proto's guaranteed response sequence for this case.
